body:
As a creative, a website is an excellent way to showcase your skills and passion.‍

And the perfect place where you can get a template that is perfect for your portfolio is Squarespace.

What is the best Squarespace templates for portfolio?

There is a specific portfolio template for each type of profession, and one of these is Tepito, which is best suited to the travel portfolio.‍

Also, I included Pazari and Nevins from Squarespace, which are perfect for graphic design and lifestyle portfolios.

"PS. Redeem your exclusive discount by entering code EBAQ at checkout."

‍On the other hand, if you’re a writer and you’re looking for the best Squarespace template for your portfolio, then Novo is for you.

All the templates on my list are highly recommended by Squarespace for portfolios, so you can just choose what template is best for your needs.

So, if you’re a creative or an artist that's doing a portfolio and you're looking for the best template for it, then here's my list for the best Squarespace templates for portfolios in 2022.

10 Best Squarespace Template for Portfolios

  1. Tepito—Best for travel portfolio
  2. Pazari—Best for graphic design portfolio
  3. Nevins—Best for lifestyle portfolio
  4. Utica—Best for video portfolio
  5. Elliot—Best for photography portfolio
  6. Matsuya—Best for personal portfolio
  7. Novo—Best for writing portfolio
  8. Carson—Best for fashion design portfolio
  9. Lange—Best for sports portfolio
  10. Nolan—Best for artist portfolio

1. Tepito

If you’re looking for the best Squarespace template that is perfect for a travel portfolio, then Tepito is a great option.

The best Squarespace template for travel portfolios.

With an eye-catching graphic, the homepage includes a bio, latest work, and current location that is suitable for a travel portfolio.

This is also in contrast to project pages, which contain a large background image followed by a series of photos that slowly appear as you scroll down the page.

When it comes to capturing things that happen outside, this template from Squarespace is a perfect fit when you’re traveling.

You may also publish your location on Tepito so that potential clients can get in touch directly with you if they need it.

So, if your hobby is traveling and you need a Squarespace template that is matched to your portfolio, then Tepito is for you.

‍Download Tepito Squarespace Template

2. Pazari

If you're a graphic designer and you’re looking for the best Squarespace template for your graphic design portfolio, then Pazari is highly recommended.

The best Squarespace template for graphic design portfolios.

You'll be able to amaze your clients with your graphic design skills if you choose this Squarespace template.‍

The Pazari template places big graphics at the top and bottom of the page to make them more noticeable, but it still looks simple and clean.‍

If a visitor clicks on the “People” cover image, for example, they will be taken to a page with all of the images in that category.

You can also enter your phone number and a brief description of yourself under Pazari's built-in "Contact" button.

So, if you’re looking for the best Squarespace templates for a graphic design portfolio, then Pazari is a must-have.

‍Download Pazari Squarespace Template

3. Nevins

This is one of the best templates in Squarespace and is perfect if you’re doing a lifestyle portfolio.

The best Squarespace template for lifestyle portfolios.

Because of their similar minimalistic designs, Nevins and Pazari may appear similar, but the former has a few additional features that make it stand apart.

Also, because the photos on the Nevins home page are smaller, three images can be displayed in a row instead of just two here.

As a result, the description appears in the white area below each image rather than on top of it.

As a final touch, the category pages themselves begin by default with a small text blurb in which you can describe particular projects.‍

So, if you’re looking for the best Squarespace template for a lifestyle portfolio, then Nevins is a great choice.

‍Download Nevins Squarespace Template

4. Utica

The Utica is an excellent choice if you’re looking for the best Squarespace template for your video portfolio

The best Squarespace template for video portfolios.

Because of its custom design template and simple navigation, this is ideal for showcasing your art in a video portfolio.

The Utica features a lovely image of your most recent work at the bottom, with your name at the top.

There are many layout choices, and uploading photographs is simple using the drag-and-drop functionality.‍

When it comes to the template itself, you can customize it to match your own design aesthetics, colors, and personality, which is perfect for a video portfolio.‍

So, if you’re looking for the best templates from Squarespace that are suitable for your needs, then Utica is for you.

‍Download Utica Squarespace Template

5. Elliot

If you’re a photographer and you're looking for the best template from Squarespace that is perfect for a photography portfolio, this is a good choice.

The best Squarespace template for photography portfolios.

Elliot is a template from Squarespace that is suitable for a photography portfolio, with a slider for images that runs horizontally.

Among the choices is a horizontal slider with a large number of photographs that is good for your portfolio.‍

You'll find that this slider design works nicely with portrait-oriented images, which are also great for other portfolios.

Also, the navigation bar at the top of the page provides access to different project galleries.

So, if you have to have the best template from Squarespace that is suitable for your photography portfolio, then Elliot is a must-have.

‍Download Elliot Squarespace Template

6. Matsuya

If you’re looking for the best Squarespace template that is perfect for a personal portfolio, then Matsuya is an excellent choice.

The best Squarespace template for personal portfolios.

On the homepage, you can display up to 15 photographs, making it easy for visitors to see your best work.

An image gallery pops up when you click over an image on Matsuya's one-page portfolio template from Squarespace, and it is perfect for you to show your personal work.

Also, you can browse through an image gallery slideshow using the side arrows or keyboard commands, similar to how you would on Pinterest's grid of images.

In addition, if you're a creative, you can also use this Squarespace theme to showcase your wedding or portrait photography as well as anything else you do.

‍Matsuya is not just for personal portfolios; it can also be used by a professional to have a nice and better portfolio.

Download Matsuya Squarespace Template

7. Novo

The Novo template from Squarespace displays two photos of the project's cover side by side, separated only by a thin white line that is suitable if you're doing a writing portfolio.‍

The best Squarespace template for writing portfolios.

But because of a lack of space, there is no text above or below the photographs in this post.

Instead of putting the text on top or below, when a visitor hovers over an image, the text appears.

Logo designers, interior designers, fashion designers, and anybody else looking for a portfolio with a bit of creativity will find Novo to be an excellent choice.

And when you click on an image in a category, you'll be sent to a page with a large hero image, text, and additional photos.

So, if you’re looking for the best template from Squarespace that is perfect for writing a portfolio, then Novo is for you.

‍Download Novo Squarespace Template

8. Carson

Carson makes your portfolio the main attraction on this template's homepage that is simple and clean.

The best Squarespace template for fashion design portfolios.

There is a full-screen image and a list of hyperlinked titles that is perfect for a fashion design portfolio.‍

To share a few details about the set of images you're sharing, simply click on the title of the image in question.

Also, Carson has full-screen photographs that fill each page, and when visitors have finished scrolling, they are taken back to the homepage so they can see more.

And lastly, a contact page and a list of previous clients can be found at the top of the website.

So, if you’re searching for the best Squarespace template that is perfect for a fashion design portfolio, then Carson is an excellent choice.

‍Download Carson Squarespace Template

9. Lange

If you’re going to make a sports portfolio and you’re searching for the best Squarespace template for it, this is a great choice.

The best Squarespace template for sports portfolios.

Using full-screen photographs, Lange displays your photos in a similar way to Carson.

Visitors can learn more about your work by clicking on the photographs on the main page, which takes them to a new page.

Also, text boxes can be included between photos and full-screen images to draw attention to specific parts of your sports portfolio.‍

This template has a more visible menu bar, making it easier for visitors to access your portfolio, your contact page, and an information section where you may share more about yourself.

So, if you’re looking for the best Squarespace templates for sports portfolios, then Lange is a wise choice.

‍Download Lange Squarespace Template

10. Nolan

Nolan is a dark-colored portfolio template with a full-width case study section that is suitable if you’re doing an artist portfolio.

The best Squarespace template for artist portfolios.

Additional pages make it a great option for creatives, but the text is completely customizable, so you may change page titles and content to whatever you need.

Other than that, for showcasing web design, graphics, marketing materials, or other visual content, the portfolio pages have plenty of room for text and large photos.

Also, Nolan can also easily delete pages that you no longer use.

In order to show your abilities as an artist, you can use this template from Squarespace to utilize your design.‍

So, if you’re an artist and you’re looking for the best Squarespace for your portfolio, then Nolan is for you.

‍Download Nolan Squarespace Template

Conclusions

Squarespace is the best place where you can get the perfect templates for your specific portfolio.

Is Squarespace good for portfolios?

If you’re going to ask me if Squarespace is good for portfolios, then the answer is yes.

In fact, Squarespace is not only for the ideal portfolio, but it is also perfect for creatives in general.‍

If you’re interested, you can also check out my other article where I featured the Best Squarespace Template for Artists.‍

On the other hand, I included in my list the Elliot and Carson design that is best for photography and lifestyle portfolios, and it is from Squarespace.
